Motivation start karati hai; habit badhati rehti hai.
"Believe karo ya na karo—right tum hi ho."
"Success start hoti self-discipline se."
Khamoshi se mehnat karo, success shor machaye.
"Opportunity na aaye, darwaza khud banao."
Tanav ke khilaf sabse badi hathiyar humari yeh shamta hai ki hum ek vichar ko dusre par chun sakein.
Confidence ke bina success, bina foundation ghar jaisi.
"Dictionary me hi work se pehle success aata."
"Strong mind = strong body jaisa."
"Failure se darr nahi; try na karne se darr."
"Bade sapne, chhota start."
Mindset sab kuch hai.
